stats.tell_line: a warning cue that speeds up as the missile closes in: the ground ring follows the locked player for 2.5 s while the lock-on beep rises 2 -> 8 Hz, the ring then stops (1.5 s) and the missile descends 1.5 s
stats.counter_play: leave the 5 u sphere within 1.5 s (13.5 u of running at full speed; <= 11 u even from the back of a 6-wide nook), or put a prop, a spire pad, a bastion wall or a tile slab between you and the sky. (ENEMIES.md words it 'break line of sight'; the D-025 terrain has almost nothing overhead, so the working answer is 'leave the sphere' - both readings are named here, neither canon sentence changed.)
